visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky nav/header with backdrop-saturate-150 and 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10). Dashboard cards and service detail sections use flat backgrounds with 1px subtle border.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background to eliminate digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.effects: Glowing gradient line (Tracing Beam) on the active 'Start a Project' CTA. All containers with border must have padding (p-8) to avoid text collision.

grids.homepage_services: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. gap-8 to gap-12. Alternating alignments with empty cells to create negative space and offset alignment. Do not perfectly fill 100% of the grid.
grids.service_detail: Desktop: Left column sticky (col-span-4) with Service Title and CTA; Right column scrolling (col-span-8) with Process, Deliverables, Outcomes.

layouts.homepage: 8 service rows staggered with overlapping images and large editorial typography. Ensure generous spacing (py-24 or py-32). Avoid Bootstrap columns.
layouts.service_detail_page: Hero with dark overlay (bg-black/40 - never exceed 50%), followed by split-pane bento grid.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav (Crystal Glass variant, z-50), logo left, center links, right 'Start a Project' CTA. Never use fully transparent background.
layouts.contact_form: Shadcn dialog/modal. Auto-prefill the selected service in the Select component when opened via a specific service page.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for premium weight.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade-in and slide-up for service details. Items staggered entrance.
motion.interactions: Hover states on service rows: image scales up slightly (scale-105) with transform transition. Button hover: specific element transitions, never transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Teal text on dark background must be bright enough (#00E5C0). Text over images must have drop shadow or background overlay.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='start-project-btn', data-testid='service-link-seo').

media.image_style: High contrast, dark editorial vibe. Max mobile height 80vh to avoid blocking content.
media.video: Optional dark ambient background video for the main hero.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion 3D for subtle scrolling perspective shifts. No heavy 3D canvases required for these text/image-heavy detail pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 8 service detail pages using dynamic routing (e.g., /services/:slug in React/Router).
Implement the 'Start a Project' CTA to open a Shadcn Dialog containing the contact form.
Pass the current service name as a parameter/state to the contact form so the 'Service Required' Select field is auto-prefilled based on context.

For the homepage, reorder the 8 services into staggered rows using the Mode A Tetris Grid. Each row must have a distinct editorial layout (e.g., alternating left/right image placements) and not just be a repetitive list.
Use Playfair Display for all H1/H2 headings and Satoshi for body text.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all clickable and interactive elements.
Use Shadcn UI for the contact form, dropdowns, and dialogs, completely stripping default Vercel styles to match the dark/teal editorial theme.
Ensure the hero images on service detail pages use a maximum opacity of bg-black/50 overlay.
Ensure all Shadcn components are integrated using .js files as specified.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
